raw.name: Physical examination
raw.description: Excludes pelvic, rectal, and breast examinations unless clinically indicated. See Section 8.2.1.

raw.name: Symptom-directed physical assessment
raw.description: Conducted at the discretion of the PI or qualified personnel.

raw.name: Vital signs (triplicate)
raw.description: Measured in triplicate after participant has been sitting at least 5 minutes. Vital signs should be taken before ECG tracing. See Sections 8.2.2 and 10.12.

raw.name: ECG 12-lead (triplicate; central)
raw.description: Collect triplicate ECGs before all blood samples. ECG may be repeated at the discretion of the investigator.
